messages.subject: [Rsiena-help] New error after updating to newest version
messages.subject_clean: [Rsiena-help] New error after updating to newest version
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I have been working on a few additional tests using RSiena on a model that I
had put together for submission back in December. The paper was
conditionally accepted but the reviewers asked a few questions. All was
going fine, and the model was running well yesterday. However, I decided to
update RSiena from CRAN and am now receiving the following error when I try
to call

sample<-siena07(mymodel, data=mydata, effects=myeff)

Loading Tcl/Tk interface...done
Error in the initializeFRAN(z, x, data, effects, prevAns, initC, profileData
= profileData, :
REAL() can only be applied to a 'numeric', no a 'NULL'

I am on a windows machine.

Can someone help me interpret the error message and/or let me know what they
think might be the cause?

Michelle Shumate
Associate Professor
Department of Communication
University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign
http://www.michelleshumate.com
http://sectorblender.blogspot.com/
To make appointments please visit: http://tinyurl.com/shumate-appointments

messages.body_plain:
Dear Michelle,

Have you recreated the data, model and effects objects? If not, that 
would be worth doing.

If this doesn't help, I'll have a look for you if you send me the data and 
commands.

Please also send the result of a sessionInfo() command so I know exactly 
what version of R, Windows, etc.

Regards,

Ruth
